outcome_statement: The overlay engine detects when an action produced no visible page change, surfaces that as an explicit signal to the decider (not just buried history), escalates to a stronger model tier when meaningfully stuck, and gives JS-heavy pages a real settle beat after navigation -- all generic, no site-specific code.
pain: A real live Etsy signup run got stuck repeating the identical no-op navigate action for its entire step budget and honestly reported failure -- the generic loop has no way to notice or recover from this.
value: Fixes the class of failure generically, on any site, matching Adam's explicit direction not to write per-site flows -- the overlay stays a universal human-like actor, not a collection of hand-coded scripts.
success_metrics: 3 consecutive identical-fingerprint observations produce stuck:true with increasing stuckCount
Genuinely differing observations never produce a false-positive stuck signal
stuckCount >= 2 tries the strongest tier first instead of cheapest-first
failure_metrics: Any Etsy-specific (or any other site-specific) code introduced
False-positive stuck detection on normal forward progress
constraints: BuilderOS system path only -- no agent hand-build
100% generic -- no site-specific selectors, URLs, or flow logic
unacceptable_result: Any site-specific code; a stuck-detector that false-positives on normal progress and blocks legitimate runs
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict
